Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

cyclingpower 0.4.0

The release that makes the package installable by someone who did not write it.

Breaking changes

  • The licence is now MIT, was GPL-3.

  • skim_power_data() is removed. Nothing in the package used it, it had no tests, and it was the only reason skimr was a dependency. The Coggan metrics are exported and compose with dplyr::summarise(): summarise(rides, np = normalised_power(power), .by = source).

  • drop_zeros() is removed. It was power[power != 0] behind an export, and nothing in the package, the app, the report template or the vignettes called it. Where you want a metric over pedalling seconds only, subset first: average_power(x[x != 0]).

  • intensity_factor() and tss() require ftp again; the 250 default introduced during this cycle is gone. A score computed against somebody else’s threshold is indistinguishable from one computed against yours, which is the same objection that removed skim_power_data().

  • start_recording(), record_samples(), stop_recording() and render_comparison() are no longer exported. They were public only so that the Shiny app, which lived in inst/, could reach them; it now lives in R/ and does not need them to be.

  • power_agreement() returns loa_lo and loa_hi, was loa_lower and loa_upper, to match bias_lo/bias_hi in the same table.

  • read_file()’s first argument is path, was file_url. It takes a path.

  • The Coggan metrics take power, was power_data. They take a numeric vector, and the old name read like a data frame.

  • vignette("compare_pms") is now vignette("cyclingpower"), and is built on demo_rides() rather than on a FIT file, so it renders for everyone rather than only for those who have installed FITfileR.

New

  • power_agreement() and chain_sources() now print the finding as a sentence above the table — which meter reads high, by how much, and from how many seconds. A chained comparison prints the assumption it rests on without being asked for it.

  • read_rides() and compare_report() take a directory as well as a spec, so a folder of ride files needs no setup: read_rides("rides/") |> align_rides() |> power_agreement().

  • tss(), intensity_factor(), collapse_protocol() and write_workout() default to ftp = 250, which is what the app, the protocol and the recording vignette already assumed. Set your own.

  • Every exported function now has a runnable example, and the reference index is grouped by what the functions do.

Under the hood

  • The Shiny app moved from inst/shiny/app.R into R/, split into app-ui.R, app-server.R and app-theme.R. It is now measured by covr and checked by R CMD check like the rest of the package, and its analysis path has tests that drive the real reactive graph through shiny::testServer(). The recorder’s radio path remains untested and untestable; see tests/testthat/test-record.R.

  • rmarkdown moved to Suggests. With skimr gone, the Imports tree falls from 55 packages to 32.

  • The directory scanner behind the app’s Rides tab is the one read_rides() uses, so the two cannot disagree about what counts as a ride file.

  • DESCRIPTION declares R (>= 4.1), which the package has needed since it started using the native pipe.
